info.title: TitanSystem supplier evidence, named deliveries and receiving origins
info.description: Manual external evidence is never authenticated supplier response. One order/product per delivery; local desktop workflow, no remote execution. All request properties are required; optional links use empty strings. Exact quantities in existing unit thousandths; amounts in cents. Shipment quantities do not reserve stock.

post.description: Only arrived delivery, exact revision. Empty existing_rejection_id creates a refusal atomically; an explicit ID binds original matching evidence without duplicating it. Rejected releases commitment but does not cancel order, schedule replacement, settle money or authorize fiscal documents. Original IDs/actor/device govern recovery. Historical arrived SQL row is frozen and terminal state is overlaid from an immutable additive ledger.

ReceiveInput.description: Physical acceptance only: accepted_milli must be positive. Complete refusal is a different operation; zero acceptance must not simulate a completed receipt.
